zh.title: 漢莎航空集團訂購20架波音737 MAX 10客機
zh.summary: 漢莎航空集團訂購20架波音737 MAX 10客機，預計2030年代初期交付
body: 漢莎航空集團（Lufthansa Group）於2026年9月17日宣布，已訂購首批20架波音737 MAX 10客機，以替換旗下較舊的空中巴士A320系列客機。本次交易係透過行使該集團於2023年購買40架737 MAX 8時獲得的選購權完成，使得漢莎航空集團累積的波音737 MAX系列單通道客機確定訂單總數增加至60架。新客機的交付預計將於2030年代初期開始。
根據漢莎航空集團公佈的資料，這筆包含20架波音737 MAX 10客機的訂單按目錄價格計算總價值約為34億美元。該集團並未公開實際議定的成交價格，亦未具體說明這批新客機未來將分配給旗下哪一家航空公司營運。在營運效益方面，漢莎航空集團估計該機型相比其所替代的舊款客機可減少約30%的燃油消耗，同時更高的載客量也有助於將每單位營運成本降低約20%。

在此之前，漢莎航空集團已將先前訂購的40架波音737 MAX 8客機全數分配給旗下的歐洲之翼航空（Eurowings）。根據歐洲之翼航空於2025年1月發布的規劃，該批MAX 8客機預計於2027年至2032年期間陸續交付，用以淘汰現有的空中巴士A319（ICAO機型代碼A319）與較舊的空中巴士A320（ICAO機型代碼A320）。該公司表示MAX 8規劃為189個座位，比其A319配置增加了39個座位。
波音737 MAX 10目前仍需取得美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）的認證。波音公司執行長凱利·奧特伯格（Kelly Ortberg）於9月16日出席摩根士丹利拉古納會議時表示，該機型的各項測試工作已經完成，目前已進入文件整理與審核階段。奧特伯格指出認證工作正在接近完成，但並未宣布確切的最終批准日期。
作為其整體機隊更新與現代化計畫的一部分，漢莎航空集團預計在2035年之前接收總計超過250架新型客機，以持續提升營運效率與降低燃料消耗。

en.title: Lufthansa Group Orders 20 Boeing 737 MAX 10 Aircraft in Fleet Renewal
en.summary: Lufthansa Group has ordered 20 Boeing 737 MAX 10 aircraft, with deliveries beginning in the early 2030s.
body: Lufthansa Group announced on September 17, 2026, that it has ordered its first 20 Boeing 737 MAX 10 aircraft to replace older Airbus A320-family planes. The transaction was made by exercising purchase options associated with its 2023 order for 40 737 MAX 8 aircraft. This latest commitment increases the group's total firm orders for the Boeing 737 MAX narrowbody family to 60 aircraft. Deliveries of the newly ordered MAX 10 jets are scheduled to begin in the early 2030s.

The airline group estimated the total list value of the 20 Boeing 737 MAX 10 aircraft at approximately $3.4 billion. Lufthansa Group did not reveal the negotiated purchase price or clarify which specific airline subsidiaries within the group will operate the MAX 10 fleet. In terms of operational efficiency, the group expects the new aircraft to consume roughly 30% less fuel than the older planes they replace, with higher seating capacity contributing to a unit cost reduction of approximately 20%.

Lufthansa Group had previously allocated all 40 of its previously ordered 737 MAX 8 aircraft to subsidiary Eurowings. Under plans outlined by Eurowings in January 2025, those MAX 8 deliveries are set to take place between 2027 and 2032 to replace its existing fleet of Airbus A319 (ICAO type code A319) and older Airbus A320 (ICAO type code A320) aircraft. Eurowings specified a 189-seat configuration for its MAX 8s, representing an increase of 39 seats compared to its A319 layout.

The Boeing 737 MAX 10 model remains subject to certification by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). Boeing Chief Executive Officer Kelly Ortberg stated at the Morgan Stanley Laguna Conference on September 16 that flight and systems testing for the aircraft was complete and the certification process was now in the documentation phase. Ortberg noted that approval was approaching, though he did not announce an exact date for final certification.

The new aircraft order forms part of Lufthansa Group's broader fleet renewal strategy. Under this ongoing program, the European airline group expects to take delivery of more than 250 new aircraft by 2035.

zh.title: 波音評估修改成本過高拆解全新777-9客機
zh.summary: 波音認定修改成本高於飛機價值，拆解全新777-9客機；該機型至今尚未交付客戶。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，波音公司在評估修改與重工成本已超過飛機本身價值後，決定拆解一架全新的 777-9 客機。截至目前，該項 777X 客機計畫仍未向任何客戶交付最終成品飛機。
在計畫進度方面，波音 777-9 測試機隊累計測試飛行已達 4,800 小時，且 777-9 與 737 MAX 10 機型均正接近認證的最後階段。波音先前已取得美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）在 4B 類類型檢驗核準（TIA 4B）下的認證試飛許可，公司預計首架交付時間為 2027 年。

en.title: Boeing Dismantles Brand-New 777-9 as Rework Costs Exceed Jet Value
en.summary: Boeing dismantled a brand-new 777-9 after rework costs exceeded the jet's value, with no finished units delivered.
body: According to a report by Simple Flying, Boeing has quietly dismantled a brand-new 777-9 aircraft after deciding that the required rework costs exceeded the overall value of the jet. To date, no finished 777X aircraft have been delivered to commercial customers.

Regarding overall program status, the Boeing 777-9 test fleet has accumulated 4,800 flight test hours, while both the 777-9 and 737 MAX 10 are nearing the final steps of certification. Boeing previously received Federal Aviation Administration approval to begin certification flight testing under Type Inspection Authorization 4B, with first delivery currently anticipated in 2027.

zh.title: GE航太稱GE9X封嚴改善不致延誤波音777X投入營運
zh.summary: GE航太表示重新設計的GE9X封嚴預計維持波音777X於2027年投入營運
body: GE航太表示，其針對GE9X發動機採取的封嚴改進措施，預計不會導致波音（Boeing）777X客機的投入營運時程遭受進一步延誤。該公司財務長指出，重新設計的GE9X中段封嚴（mid-seal）組件，將有助於讓這款長期延宕的客機維持在2027年正式投入商業營運的軌道上。
根據歷史紀錄，波音777X機隊專門採用GE航太生產的新一代GE9X導風扇發動機。該計劃先前已獲得美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）批准，依據TIA 4B階段啟動認證飛行測試，當時波音公司即預計首架新機將於2027年完成交付。

en.title: GE Aerospace Expects GE9X Mid-Seal Redesign Not to Delay Boeing 777X Entry Into Service
en.summary: GE Aerospace states its redesigned GE9X mid-seal should maintain Boeing 777X entry into service in 2027.
body: GE Aerospace has stated that issues with the GE9X engine's mid-seal are not expected to delay the entry into service of the Boeing 777X. According to the company's chief financial officer, a redesigned mid-seal component should keep Boeing's long-delayed 777X aircraft program on track for its targeted service entry in 2027.

The Boeing 777X aircraft family is exclusively powered by next-generation GE9X turbofan engines. The 777X certification program previously received approval from the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) to begin certification flight testing under Type Inspection Authorization (TIA) 4B, with first deliveries expected to take place in 2027.

zh.title: 德州空軍國民警衛隊F-16於密西根墜毀 飛官彈射獲救
zh.summary: 美德州空軍國民警衛隊F-16戰機於密西根州訓練時墜毀；飛行員彈射獲救
body: 美國德州空軍國民警衛隊一架F-16戰鬥機，於2026年9月17日在密西根州北部進行訓練飛行時墜毀。機上飛行員在墜機前成功彈射跳傘獲救，隨後被送往當地醫院接受治療。
這架戰機隸屬於駐紮於德州的第149戰鬥機聯隊（149th Fighter Wing），當時正前往阿爾佩納戰備訓練中心參加訓練。事故發生於格蘭德特拉弗斯郡布萊爾鎮區附近，地面並無人員傷亡報告。
事故發生後，地方應急官員對墜機現場周邊一英里範圍內的居民發布疏散令。第149戰鬥機聯隊表示已對此起墜機事件展開調查，目前尚未確定事故原因。

en.title: Texas Air National Guard F-16 Crashes in Michigan; Pilot Ejects Safely
en.summary: A Texas Air National Guard F-16 crashed in Michigan during training; the pilot ejected safely.
body: A Texas Air National Guard F-16 fighter jet crashed during a training flight in northern Michigan on September 17, 2026. The pilot ejected safely prior to the crash and was subsequently taken to a local hospital for medical treatment.

The aircraft was assigned to the 149th Fighter Wing, based at Joint Base San Antonio-Lackland in Texas, and was participating in training at the Alpena Combat Readiness Training Center. The incident occurred near Blair Township in Grand Traverse County, with no injuries reported on the ground.

Local emergency officials issued an evacuation order for residents within a one-mile radius of the crash site. The 149th Fighter Wing confirmed that an investigation into the cause of the crash is underway.

zh.title: 中國將於9月20日起實施北京周邊300公里空域飛行管制
zh.summary: 中國9月20日起實施北京周邊飛行管制；通航活動須核准；民航航班維持正常
body: 中國政府宣布，將自2026年9月20日起在北京周邊實施大規模空域飛行管制。新設定的管制空域以北京為中心向外延伸300公里，覆蓋面積超過28萬平方公里，管制高度自地面延伸至無限高。受管制區域涵蓋北京、天津以及河北省大部分地區，並進一步延伸至鄰近省份及渤海海域。
根據官方公布的政策概要，在該管制區內進行的所有通用航空活動均須事先獲得當局核准，申請條件包含通訊設備、航空器識別及安全申報等相關規定。相較之下，民用航空公司的定期商業航班將可繼續維持正常營運。此外，經批准的商務飛行，以及軍事、海關、警務與消防救援等公務飛行任務，亦在許可範圍之內。
獲准在該區域內飛行的航空器必須嚴格遵守經批准的飛行計畫，若需偏離航線必須取得航管許可，並須全程與空中交通管制單位保持雙向無線電通訊。同時，航空器還必須裝備能進行連續電子識別與動態追蹤的系統設備。當局指出，這項新措施是在2026年6月26日發生輕型飛機撞擊北京108層中信大廈事件後所作出的決定，當時該事故造成飛行員死亡及地面13人受傷。
除了空域管制之外，北京市政府亦針對無人航空器發布了更為嚴格的管制措施。依據將於2026年11月15日起生效的修正市府法規，北京市行政區域內將全面禁止持有、儲存、運輸無人機及其核心零組件，並禁止向個人或機構出售或出租無人機。僅有在通過安全評估後，針對災害應變、專業培訓、科學研究、製造及農業作業等特定活動方可獲得例外許可，違規者將面臨沒收航空器及最高1萬元人民幣的罰鍰。

en.title: China to Impose 300 km Flight Restriction Zone Around Beijing From September 20
en.summary: China will restrict general aviation around Beijing from September 20; airline flights remain unaffected
body: China will impose extensive airspace flight restrictions around Beijing starting on September 20, 2026. The new restricted airspace extends 300 kilometers in every direction from the capital, covering an area of more than 280,000 square kilometers from the surface to unlimited altitude. The restricted zone encompasses Beijing, Tianjin, and large portions of Hebei province, while extending into neighboring regions and the Bohai Sea.

Under the aviation policy framework, all general aviation activities within the designated zone will require prior government approval, with mandatory compliance rules covering communication protocols, aircraft identification, and security reporting. Commercial airline flights will continue operating, while approved business flights and official missions—including military, customs, police, and fire-rescue operations—will also be permitted under the regulation.

Aircraft cleared to operate in the restricted airspace must adhere strictly to approved flight plans, receive air traffic control clearance for any course deviations, and maintain continuous two-way radio communication with air traffic controllers. Permitted aircraft are also required to carry equipment enabling continuous electronic identification and tracking. Authorities announced the measures following a June 26, 2026, incident in which a light aircraft struck the 108-story CITIC Tower in Beijing, resulting in the death of the pilot and injuries to 13 people.

In addition to airspace controls, Beijing municipal authorities have enacted stricter regulations governing unmanned aerial vehicles. Under revised local rules effective November 15, 2026, possessing, storing, transporting, selling, or renting drones and their core components will be prohibited throughout Beijing's administrative area. Limited exceptions will be granted following security assessments for specific activities such as disaster response, research, manufacturing, and agricultural operations. Violators face confiscation of equipment and fines of up to 10,000 yuan.

facts.sourceQuote: China will impose sweeping restrictions on flying around Beijing starting on September 20, 2026

facts.claim: 該管制區覆蓋超過28萬平方公里，通用航空活動須取得核准，民航定期航班則維持正常營運。
facts.sourceQuote: general aviation activities within the zone will require approval, with requirements covering communications, aircraft identification and security reporting.

facts.claim: 此次新管制的背景為2026年6月26日一架輕型飛機撞擊北京108層中信大廈，造成飛行員死亡及13人受傷。
facts.sourceQuote: The restrictions follow a June 26, 2026, crash into the 108-story CITIC Tower in Beijing’s central business district.

facts.claim: 獲准飛行的航空器須遵循經批准的飛行計畫、與航管保持雙向無線電通訊並配備連續電子識別與追蹤設備。
facts.sourceQuote: Permitted aircraft must follow approved flight plans, obtain clearance for deviations and maintain two-way radio contact with air traffic control.

facts.claim: 北京另將於2026年11月15日起施行修正法規，禁止在市域內持有、儲存、運輸或租售無人機，除非獲得特定例外許可。
facts.sourceQuote: Under revised municipal regulations taking effect November 15, 2026, possessing or storing drones and their core components will be prohibited throughout Beijing’s administrative area.
